_comment: Copy to tools/apple_targets.json (gitignored) and fill in. One entry per person/iPhone. The puller reads JSON export files from watch_dir (wherever your sync client drops them) and delivers to HEC. Only secret here is hec_token — the sync client (iCloud/Dropbox) owns cloud auth outside this file.

tony._watch_dir_note: Mac+iCloud example above. Linux+Dropbox e.g. ~/Dropbox/HealthAutoExport. Any folder your sync client writes HAE JSON files into.
tony._archive_note: Set archive_dir to a LOCAL (non-cloud) path to move processed files there instead of deleting (safety window); prune it yourself. delete_after_ingest is ignored when archive_dir is set.
tony._skip_sources_note: Empty = ingest everything (Apple-hub mode). To avoid double-counting a vendor you ALSO pull directly, add its source keyword, e.g. ["Oura"]. Matched case-insensitively against each sample's HealthKit source.
tony._hr_firehose_note: false = skip the per-minute heart_rate samples (we already get resting_heart_rate daily). true = also emit apple:heartrate per-sample bpm (high volume).
